title: Output of EU VAT Number Validator (VIES)
description: One row per unique VAT number in the default dataset (bad formats, non-EU numbers and VIES outages included as free rows with status and error); a run summary in the OUTPUT record.

results.title: VAT checks
results.description: One row per number. Example: {"vatId":"IE6388047V","status":"valid","valid":true,"name":"GOOGLE IRELAND LIMITED","address":"...DUBLIN 4"}. Failed: {"vatId":"DE12","status":"invalid_format","error":"..."}.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: numbersRequested, uniqueChecked, valid, invalid, byStatus, memberStatesUnavailable, chargeLimitReached, zeroResultsReason, nextSteps.
